name: RoboSense Unveiled EOCENE SPAD-SoC Architecture and Chipsets Phoenix and Peacock: Ushering the LiDAR Industry into the Image-grade Era of High-Definition 3D Perception
summary: RoboSense debuted the EOCENE SPAD-SoC architecture, enabling rapid incubation of a diverse chipset portfolio while streamlining R&D workflows to deliver significant structural cost advantages.
